note: The fuzzer input bytes are written verbatim into a pcap file and become the packet data parsed by the library.
The checksum routine assumes the VRRP header length matches the actual allocated packet data length; this obligation is violated when the parsed layer length is inconsistent with the buffer contents.
The checksum computation reads the VRRP header through the length set above, which can overrun the heap buffer and trigger the reported write/read corruption path during checksum processing.
